burst_rule.cursor_guard: first target edit starts at the inferred input cursor
burst_rule.end: last File.Edit before the following at-least-250-ms gap or end of file
burst_rule.input_cursor: end of the preceding valid edit; never inferred from the target burst
burst_rule.one_line_guard: old and new changed spans contain no newline and remain within one source line
burst_rule.prior_input_prefix_guard: source before inferred input cursor is unchanged throughout the target burst
burst_rule.start: next File.Edit at least 250 ms after prior valid edit in the same subject-assignment-section buffer
burst_rule.target_diff: minimal common-prefix/common-suffix change from pre-burst to post-burst source

audit.candidate_unit: one valid source-changing edit after a reconstructable prior state
audit.first_pass: aggregate event and field census without source text
audit.holdout_group: subject, then assignment; never split a subject across train and evaluation
audit.revision_reason: Full exact replay succeeded; this revision predeclares a paused editor-state target-yield audit before generating burst results. The first full pass was interrupted before output because a Python character loop was too slow; a C-level suffix comparison and prior-prefix guard were frozen before retry.
audit.second_pass: bounded exact event replay with explicit mismatch and gap counts
audit.source_location_interpretation: publisher-described linearized character index; verify empirically

privacy.publisher_warning: deidentification may have missed identifying keystrokes
